title: Boxing: Essential Vocabulary
name: Boxing: Essential Vocabulary
description: The words you need to talk about Boxing precisely.
key_points: Offense: The team or player trying to score.
Defense: The team or player trying to stop scoring.
Referee/Umpire: The official enforcing the rules.
Foul: A rule violation penalized by the officials.
Overtime: Extra play to break a tie.
Seed: A ranking used to arrange tournaments.
Bracket: The tournament draw showing who plays whom.
Upset: A lower-ranked competitor beating a favorite.
Home advantage: The edge of playing on familiar ground.
Doping: Banned performance enhancement; policed by WADA.
Transfer: A player moving between clubs, sometimes for a fee.

# Boxing — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Where did Boxing originate?", "Ancient Greece"),
    ("How is Boxing scored?", "rounds / knockouts"),
    ("What is origin?", "Ancient Greece, 688 BC (Olympic)"),
    ("What is players?", "1 per side"),
    ("What is equipment?", "gloves, ring"),
    ("What is venue?", "ring"),
    ("What is scoring?", "rounds / knockouts"),
    ("What is governing body?", "Multiple bodies"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
